safety_boundary_declaration: Experimental research DAQ software and data quality monitoring tools operate strictly OUTSIDE the native vehicle safety-critical control loop. Research software is mathematically and electrically isolated from vehicle throttle, steering, and braking actuators. A data quality failure terminates experimental data logging; it DOES NOT issue automated emergency braking or steering commands to the physical vehicle.

safety_abort.purpose: Protect human life, physical test personnel, and facility assets from mechanical, spatial, or operational hazards.
safety_abort.control_authority: Physical Safety Marshal, Hardwired Perimeter Interlocks, Certified Vehicle Operator.
safety_abort.actuation_mechanism: Hardwired Cat 4 / SIL-3 physical safety circuit, independent wireless E-Stop power cutoff relay, or vehicle native mechanical brakes.

triggers.condition: Manual or wireless E-Stop button depressed by Safety Marshal or Operator.
triggers.system_action: Cuts vehicle traction motor drive power immediately via certified relay; brings vehicle to fail-safe mechanical stop.
triggers.daq_action: Flags current recording as ABORTED_SAFETY; freezes video and telemetry recording buffer.

triggers.condition: Perimeter physical barrier gate opened or physical safety light curtain breached.
triggers.system_action: Hardwired interlock loop breaks; immediate traction power disconnect.

triggers.condition: Any human observed stepping inside the dynamic vehicle travel envelope or test buffer.
triggers.system_action: Safety Marshal depresses wireless E-Stop instantly.

triggers.condition: Vehicle steering failure, tire blow-out, runaway acceleration, or physical obstacle collision.
triggers.system_action: Operator / Safety Marshal engages native emergency stop.

data_invalidation_abort.purpose: Invalidate and isolate experimental data captures that fail scientific integrity, temporal continuity, or sensor completeness requirements.
data_invalidation_abort.control_authority: Automated DAQ Recording Daemon & Data Operations Lead.
data_invalidation_abort.actuation_mechanism: Software-level data container tagging and pipeline termination. NO VEHICLE ACTUATOR COMMANDS ISSUED.
data_invalidation_abort.operational_protocol: Upon data invalidation, DAQ marks recording as ABORTED_DATA_INVALID. The test vehicle continues nominal operation or is brought to a controlled stop by the vehicle operator following standard operational procedures.

triggers.condition: Any commissioned camera (A, B, or C) drops >= 1 video frame during active trial.
triggers.daq_action: Terminates active event container; tags package as ABORTED_DATA_FRAME_DROP; moves package to aborted_runs/ archive.

triggers.condition: CAN bus message gap > 20.0 ms for vehicle speed, brake state, or yaw rate.
triggers.daq_action: Tags package as ABORTED_DATA_CAN_TIMEOUT; invalidates event run.

triggers.condition: PTP grandmaster loses GNSS lock, or local slave node drifts > component limit, or step correction detected.
triggers.daq_action: Tags package as ABORTED_DATA_CLOCK_DESYNC; requires 5-minute burn-in re-lock.

triggers.condition: Secondary LiDAR or Radar stream disconnects or packet loss exceeds 0.01%.
triggers.daq_action: Tags package as ABORTED_DATA_SECONDARY_DROPOUT; marks secondary zone as UNVERIFIED.

triggers.condition: NVMe ingest buffer queue exceeds 80% capacity or disk write latency exceeds 50.0 ms.
triggers.daq_action: Tags package as ABORTED_DATA_STORAGE_OVERFLOW; halts new capture sessions until flushed.

triggers.condition: SHA-256 hash calculation mismatch during session close or Merkle root computation failure.
triggers.daq_action: Tags package as ABORTED_DATA_PROVENANCE_FAIL; isolates corrupt block.

post_abort_lifecycle.rule: Aborted runs (both Safety and Data Invalidation) are permanently quarantined in outputs/aborted_runs/ with full diagnostic logs. They CANNOT be promoted to DATASET_READY_FOR_REVIEW and CANNOT be used as valid experimental evidence.
